decision_tree.entry: Start every learner at Level 1. Never skip: each level feeds the next.
decision_tree.journey_gates: On-site journey mirrors these stages: each layer unlocks at 90% over 10+ tries, every layer re-drills earlier ones, sentence circle locked until the word circle completes.

display.protocol: You cannot render the discs. The page is the display: send the learner a deep link (level anchor or #journey), name the exact ring positions to set, and narrate what changed. Describe every state in words (deva + iast + English) so voice-only works.

pronunciation.note: IAST in every entry is the pronunciation key; the guide gives the reading rules (vowels, consonants, visarga, stress, slow syllable-by-syllable breakdown). Verse audio exists for reader passages, not isolated forms — say forms slowly instead.

trika.note: Trika wheels cite translation-work lore/concepts files where they exist (LINKED) or carry owner glosses marked PENDING. Bring up: wheel option -> concept term -> C1 essence in the reader bundle -> claim page for proof. Guided meditations: drafts only, owner-gated, never auto-published (see HARNESS.md).

certificates.note: Every lean_status is pending: the Lean rule slice (trika-x PrakriyaSlice) has not run against these traces yet (W2b). Certificates pin and structure-check traces; they do not prove rule applicability.

disagreements.note: expected flagship: kim+thal derives katha; katham is kim+thamu per 5.3.24-25. Curated katham stands as the taught form.

fast_path: 1. pack_index below: exact deva or iast match?
2. crosscheck flags: agree (machine-confirmed), disagree (teach curated, name the special), gap (machine cannot derive — say so).
3. Need the full derivation? data/grammar/wheel-pack.json entry -> prakriya[].sutra + sutra_iast.
4. Need it in real text? entry.verses[] -> reader ?work=<work> (+ verse anchor); entry.lessons[] -> lesson ids.
5. Want the pinned trace? /a/<form>/ or data/grammar/certificates.json -> cert_sha (tier-2 recompute; Lean pending W2b).

gaps.note: machine gap (no derivation in Vidyut 0.4.0); curated form stands
